description: Shifts a pitch signal by whole octaves, four either way

params.text: Sets the shift in octaves, from -4 to +4; click a circle to choose one, or right-click to type a number

inputs.text: The pitch to be shifted; with nothing patched, the module puts out whole-volt values of its own
Shifts the pitch by the nearest whole number of volts at this input, on top of the shift already set

outputs.text: The pitch with the octave shift added, a volt per octave
